summary: Restoration is framed through an EU-wide commitment to put measures in place on at least 20% of EU land and sea areas by 2030, with measures intended for all ecosystems that need restoration by 2050; no Finland-specific hectare target is given. For conservation and the land sector, the LULUCF framework sets a -310 Mt CO2-eq carbon-sink target by 2030, also reported as 310 Mt CO2 net removals and described as 42 Mt CO2-eq above the 2016-2018 average. Finland's listed national target is -2,889 Kt CO2eq for 2030. Finland's land context is 73.6% forest (246,634 km2), 8.3% agriculture, 6.5% wetland and 0.5% grassland, so the pledges are chiefly carbon-sector and EU-wide ecosystem measures; no separate Finnish sustainable-farming area is stated.

targets.context: EU-wide land-and-sea benchmark; it is not a 20% share of Finland's 335,269 km2 land area, so no national hectare figure can be derived.

targets.metric: EU LULUCF carbon sinks and net greenhouse-gas removals
targets.context: Collective EU managed-land commitment; Finland's forest area is 246,634 km2 (73.6%), but the EU-wide volume is not apportioned in this passage.
